text:
morgan: OOM observed on shard-prod-14 at ~04:07 UTC. Appears to be recurring KV residency drift post-batch-merge. quick tail and link: https://logs.company/oom/1788888888

Talia: paste the tail?

morgan: short scrape:
```
heap.used_mb: 11200 -> 22400 (4h)
kv.residency.count: 800k -> 3.2M
kv.hot_keys.top10: small set grows 3x during merge windows
gc.pause.p95: 16ms -> 58ms
```

ben: pattern looks like sticky residency combined with fragmentation from many small allocations. i'll own a targeted alloc-sample run and survivor histograms in staging. due: 2026-03-26 EOD.

ash: i'll run a soft-evict canary at 72% on 2 nodes and add a pre/post hot-key snapshot. due: 2026-03-25 09:00 PST.

morgan: infra note: autoscaler didn't react; propose an advisory rule on residency growth. ben, can you add a synthetic that reproduces merge workload?

ben: yes, i'll extend the tests repo with merge-heavy workload: https://git.company/tests/kv-merge-sim and attach run IDs.

morgan: list compact action items we can paste into tracker (short bullets):

ben: Action: alloc-sampling + survivor histograms -> owner: ben -> due: 2026-03-26 EOD -> success: top 3 survivor paths + PRs

ash: Action: canary soft-evict 72% + hot-key snapshots -> owner: ash -> due: 2026-03-25 09:00 PST -> success: <4% client errors and >=12% peak residency drop

Talia: Action: propose residency-growth advisory autoscale rule -> owner: talia -> due: 2026-03-24 noon PST -> success: rule validated in staging for 2 synthetic runs

morgan: Action: update postmortem tracker + add weekly residency heatmap job -> owner: morgan -> due: 2026-03-24 EOD -> success: tracker links and recurring job created

ops-bot: Created issue: INF-5001 - "KV residency drift after batch-merge / followups" (https://jira.company/browse/INF-5001). Assigned: ben, ash, talia, morgan.

ben: starting alloc-sampling in staging now. will attach flamegraphs and histograms to INF-5001.

ash: scheduling canary and will post dashboard link to the issue after 12h.

Talia: drafting autoscale advisory rule and simulation plan.

morgan: i'll update the tracker and post a nightly summary to #eng-oncall for 5 days.

ops-bot: Incident note appended to INF-5001: "Recurring KV residency drift during batch merges; follow-ups assigned; canary + profiling in progress."

ben: ack. aiming to deliver initial findings by Thu.

ash: will report canary metrics after 24h.

Talia: will validate autoscale advisory in staging by tomorrow noon.

morgan: closing loop here. paste PRs/dashboards into INF-5001. reconvene at retro next Fri to decide long-term fixes (eviction heuristics, allocator changes, API-level guards). :calendar:

ben: end."
